question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "ever."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****
 

__
 
• 
 
**"Ever" **means at any time. (किसी भी समय)

 
 
• 
 
The word **"ever"** is used in the blank to emphasize the idea of looking closely at the cat.

 
 
• 
 
It implies that the observation requires a level of attention or scrutiny that might not have happened before.

 
 
• 
 
The sentence is essentially saying,* "If you have at any time looked closely at the cat..."*

 
 
• 
 
The use of **"ever" **adds emphasis to the act of closely examining the cat, making the statement more impactful.

 
 
• 
 
So, the correct answer is Option 1.

 
 
• Correct paragraph:

It is often said that if__ you want a pet to look up to you, get a dog. If you want a pet that looks straight __at__ you, get a horse. For an animal that looks down __on__ you, the cat must surely __fit__ this description. Cats are their own bosses. They have little or no regard for anyone or anything. If you have **__ever__** looked closely at the cat, you will observe that it looks at you from the corner of its eyes, almost condescendingly. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Never: **at no time; not ever. (कभी नहीं; कदापि नहीं)
 
• **Sometime: **at a time that you do not know exactly or have not yet decided. (समय जो नहीं मालूम कि ठीक-ठीक कब या जो अभी निश्चित नहीं; कभी)
 
• Whenever: The word "whenever" is used to indicate any time or every time that a particular situation occurs. (जब कभी भी)
